_comment: Device inventory + per-device port assignments for the parallel runner. Ports are chosen to NOT clash with a manually-started Appium on 4723. Each device gets a unique appium_port + system_port + mjpeg_port so two UiAutomator2 sessions can run at once. 'marker' is the default pytest marker run on that device when no marker is passed on the CLI.

devices.name: OnePlus-CPH2401
devices._extra_caps_note: enforceXpath1 works around 'Cannot set AccessibilityNodeInfo field mSealed to true' XPath bug seen on this OnePlus/Android 14 ROM during date navigation.
